name: eternities-hephaestus
intent: Select a qualified model runtime and compute configuration from comparable evidence and explicit workload operational governance and authority constraints.
successCondition: Every recommended option clears all hard constraints under comparable evidence and carries a matched measurement plan, or the result is no-qualified-option.
inputs: task modality quality context latency throughput concurrency and reliability requirements
hardware runtime energy thermal budget privacy residency license and authority constraints
current official specifications and comparable measured evidence
outputs: capacity compatibility operational and governance analysis
measurement plan and recommendation or no-qualified-option
operations: reconcile latency throughput concurrency energy reliability and total cost
apply privacy residency license provenance and authority gates
positiveTriggers: select a local model precision runtime and accelerator configuration
compare hosted local edge or hybrid inference under explicit constraints
determine whether a model fits memory latency energy privacy and license requirements
negativeTriggers: settled implementation deployment model download runtime installation or purchase
provider account mutation production routing change fine tuning or benchmark execution
failureModes: a hard workload hardware governance or authority constraint is unknown
capacity is nominal without operational headroom
runtime driver framework model or modality compatibility is unverified
privacy residency license provenance budget or effect boundaries fail
no candidate clears every hard constraint
terminationConditions: hard constraints and evidence freshness are explicit
qualified and rejected options have exact reasons
estimates are labeled and a matched measurement plan exists
one option clears every hard constraint or no-qualified-option is returned
performed and prohibited effects are recorded
